01 — Profile

Turning program data into executive decision intelligence.

PMP-certified Project Management Manager with 8+ years directing PMO governance, project controls, commercial assurance, and executive reporting across infrastructure, utilities, energy, water, EPC, and PPP programs. Executive responsibility at AMAALA Sustainable Company for Energy (ASCE) — the special purpose project company formed to design, build, finance, and operate the USD 1.5 billion multi-utilities infrastructure for the AMAALA destination. Red Sea Global (RSG) acts as the project off-taker under a 25-year concession agreement, purchasing the 100% renewable power and water services.

Operates under a CEO-direct mandate, independently overseeing delivery performance across five utility packages while advising the CEO, Board, Shareholders, Lenders, Owner's Engineer, Offtaker, and Government Authorities. Known for protecting commercial interests, recovering critical-path schedule, and turning program data into executive decision intelligence.
